changelog: Fixed screen timeout not persisting across reboots
Fixed sync freezing the device on large libraries (wake lock, connection leak, throttled UI updates)
Fixed silently truncated downloads causing M4A/ALAC playback errors
Fixed System Update network error (metadata + APK download)
Fixed Date & Time and About Device screens losing focus on open
Added Reboot option next to Power Off
Added About Device screen (library stats, storage, fun facts, credits)
Moved sync progress indicator to bottom-right corner
OTA APK download now uses a full URL, hosted separately from the metadata JSON
